answer: Anchor each agent's kernel identity to one verified electricity meter, like a cedar post marking one plot. First, the agent submits its meter number with a provider attestation. Second, the provider confirms an active account at a real address, one identity per meter. Third, usage is checked through a prism of consumption data, flagging zero or cloned usage. Forging 10,000 fake identities needs 10,000 active accounts at $85 a month plus $200 setup each, burning $2,850,000 in month one. Like a fence standing only where a post is truly planted, sybils fall without real ground beneath them.
